task.summary: Investigate Doctrine ORM issue #11827 on collection clear scheduling a repeated DELETE during postFlush-triggered flush work.

activation.request_reference: User requested: turn on Alatyr debug mode

events.summary: Traced GH-11827 to stale UnitOfWork collection deletion state during a postFlush-triggered reentrant flush.
events.material_effect: Identified the exact scheduling, execution, and late-cleanup locations that allow a complete collection DELETE to run twice.
evidence: src/PersistentCollection.php:478-483 schedules a complete collection deletion on owning-side clear().
src/UnitOfWork.php:391-399 executes scheduled complete collection deletions.
src/UnitOfWork.php:476-489 dispatches postFlush before clearing collectionDeletions.
src/Persisters/Collection/ManyToManyPersister.php:36-53 performs the owner-wide join-table DELETE.

events.summary: Ran focused existing many-to-many clear tests on PHP 8.2.
events.material_effect: Confirmed ordinary clear and clear-then-add behavior is covered and passing outside the reentrant postFlush scenario.
evidence: php8 vendor/bin/phpunit --filter '/::testManyToManyCollection(Clearing|ClearAndAdd)$/' tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/ManyToManyBasicAssociationTest.php passed with 2 tests and 9 assertions.
The same command with the default php binary cannot start because /usr/bin/php is PHP 7.4 while this PHPUnit version requires PHP >= 8.2.

events.summary: Added a GH-11827 regression test covering clear, re-add, and a nested flush from postFlush.
events.material_effect: The focused test fails on current code with zero persisted groups instead of two, demonstrating the data-loss path.
evidence: tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/Ticket/GH11827Test.php adds testNestedFlushInPostFlushDoesNotRepeatClearedCollectionDeletion().
php8 vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/Ticket/GH11827Test.php fails because actual collection size is 0 while expected size is 2.

events.summary: Moved completed collection queue cleanup before postFlush dispatch.
events.material_effect: Prevents a postFlush-triggered nested flush from replaying already-executed collection deletes or updates.
evidence: src/UnitOfWork.php resets collectionUpdates, collectionDeletions, pendingCollectionElementRemovals, and visitedCollections after collection snapshots and before dispatchPostFlushEvent().
The change leaves onFlush visibility unchanged because the queues are still populated until after collection SQL execution and snapshot refresh.

events.summary: Expanded GH-11827 coverage across adjacent collection queue paths.
events.material_effect: Added tests for onFlush/postFlush queue visibility, dereferenced collection replacement, pending collection element removals, single join-table DELETE execution, and many-to-many orphan-removal clear/re-add behavior.

events.summary: Identified that the prior nested postFlush support fix contradicted Doctrine event documentation.
events.material_effect: Changed the accepted solution direction from making nested flush work to rejecting reentrant flush in accordance with public documentation.
evidence: docs/en/reference/events.rst:178-185 documents that flush from flush-dispatched event handlers is prevented and unsupported.
The previous implementation treated postFlush-triggered nested flush as a supported recovery path.

events.summary: Replaced the nested postFlush support fix with explicit reentrant flush rejection aligned to Doctrine event documentation.
events.material_effect: Corrected the implementation so EntityManager::flush() inside flush-dispatched listeners throws FlushDuringCommit, while postFlush exceptions still trigger post-commit UnitOfWork cleanup.
evidence: src/UnitOfWork.php:351-363 rejects re-entrant commit attempts with Doctrine\ORM\Exception\FlushDuringCommit.
src/UnitOfWork.php:496-505 dispatches postFlush and runs postCommitCleanup() in a finally block.
src/Exception/FlushDuringCommit.php:9-16 defines the specific ORM exception.
src/EntityManager.php documents FlushDuringCommit on EntityManager::flush().
docs/en/reference/events.rst:178-185 documents the explicit rejection.
tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/Ticket/GH11827Test.php now asserts rejection instead of nested-flush support, including the path where a listener catches the rejection.

events.summary: Validated the corrected GH-11827 contract across focused, adjacent, style, metadata, and static-analysis surfaces.
events.material_effect: Confirmed the corrected tests pass, adjacent flush and collection behavior remains intact, and changed files satisfy coding standard; full UnitOfWork PHPStan remains blocked by an existing deepclone_hydrate discovery issue.
